tool_config.name: start_emergency
tool_config.description: Record an Emergency and alert the office, right after you said the safety line and just before you transfer the call with transfer_to_number. The backend records an Emergency request, texts every Coordinator and puts a pop-up on the office dashboard. Returns {"ref": "R-1042"}, or {"error": "..."} if it could not be recorded; transfer the call either way. Never read the ref out.

request_body_schema.description: Only what the Foreman already said on this call. Never ask for any of it.

summary.description: What happened, in the Foreman's own words (for example "we hit a gas line").

job_id.description: The job_id find_jobs returned for the Job the Foreman named. Leave it out unless find_jobs already returned exactly one Job.

job_spoken.description: The Job in the Foreman's own words, if he already named one. Leave it out if he did not.
